description: This file defines a service for managing evidence packages linked to audits, including creation, retrieval, integrity verification, and linking to approval records. It handles JSON evidence data, hashing, and storage references, and interacts with a database and audit service.

classes.name: EvidenceError
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling evidence-related errors.

classes.name: EvidenceService
classes.description: Main service class for creating, retrieving, and linking evidence packages with audit and integrity checks.

methods.name: create_evidence_package
methods.description: Creates an evidence package with linked artifacts, manifest, and audit record.

methods.name: get_evidence_package
methods.description: Retrieves an evidence package by ID, verifying manifest integrity.

methods.name: get_evidence_artifact
methods.description: Retrieves an artifact by ID, verifying its hash for integrity.

methods.name: link_evidence_to_approval
methods.description: Links an evidence package to an approval record with audit logging.
